ShadowMountPlus 1.7-beta5fix1, GPL-3.0
https://github.com/drakmor/ShadowMountPlus/tree/1.7-beta5fix1
Derived modules: lifecycle hooks, firmware offsets, remote memory access, assembly bridge.
Local modifications: dedicated socket/protocol, per-thread launch matching, abort-on-error bridge, no title installation hook, no foreign bridge recovery.

Only headers required by Goda native build targets are included; unused UI, locale and storage-management headers have been omitted. Upstream license retained.
